rationale: Both Tom and Dhanush are founders building in the robotics space, with complementary technical depths. Tom is focused on humanoid robotics and manipulation at Ruyi Dynamics, while Dhanush brings full-stack roboticist expertise in perception, ROS architecture, and the software stack (Python, OpenCV, Gazebo) that underpins modern robotics systems. Their combined domain coverage—hardware/manipulation plus perception/software architecture—represents the kind of technical pairing that often strengthens robotics ventures.
intro_message: Tom Zhanh, meet Dhanush Baktha — both robotics founders with complementary focus areas (Tom on humanoid robotics and manipulation, Dhanush on perception and ROS architecture) who could explore synergies in technical approach.
